gist.summary: Added GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource to gen.pollinations.ai. The RFC 9728 response identifies the gen resource, points authorization_servers to the matching enter.pollinations.ai origin (including staging), declares header-based bearer authentication, and links resource documentation. OAuth discovery clients can now find enter's existing authorization-server metadata without hardcoded URLs. Also linked the discovery document from llms.txt and added a focused route test.
